noPermission.title: Not open for you
noPermission.body: Instructions open for people who report work at this station. Ask your team leader.

open.title: For this work
open.hint: The instruction of its operation and the spec for its size open
open.prompt: Scan a bundle at {operation} to see version {n}.
open.paper: A work order's page or a printed instruction: scan the bundle's ticket instead. The size is the bundle's, and the screen always shows the version in force.
open.offline: No network: a bundle opened on this tablet before still opens, as of then.
open.workOrder: {what} {code}: a work order has many sizes. Scan a bundle's ticket.
open.wrongLabel: {what} {code}: this screen opens a bundle's ticket.

notOnTablet.title: Not on this tablet
notOnTablet.body: {code} was not opened here before the network went. It opens when the network is back.

failed.refused: This bundle has no operation to show here. Ask your team leader.

notFound.title: Bundle not found here
notFound.body: {code} is not a bundle of this site. Check the ticket.

none.title: No instruction yet
none.body: {operation} has no published instruction. The spec for this size is on the other tab.

steps.mediaOffline: The picture is not on this tablet: it shows when the network is back.
steps.mediaFailed: The picture could not be opened. The words below still hold.
steps.otherLanguage: Not written in your language yet: shown in another one.
steps.tick: Tick this step on the Operation screen before Finish.

seen.held: Look at every step first: {seen} of {count}
seen.failed: Seen was not saved: the office did not take it. Tap Seen again.

zoom.title: Photo
zoom.area: The photo: move it with a finger

spec.notKept: The spec for this size is not on this tablet: it shows when the network is back.
spec.failed: The spec for this size could not be read. Try again in a moment.
spec.noMeasures: No measures are written for this size.
spec.measuresNote: The size's own measures. Ask your team leader for a garment measure not listed here.
spec.noMaterials: No materials are planned for this bundle's size.
spec.routeTitle: The operations of this work order
spec.pdfNote: The full spec pages with the label positions are the tech pack's: the office prints them.

banner.title: Spec changed
banner.newer: Revision {newer} of this spec is out. This work order is made to revision {pinned}: keep to revision {pinned} until the office decides.
banner.withdrawn: Revision {pinned} of this spec was withdrawn. Keep to the pages you have and ask the office before going on.

decided.FINISH_OLD: Decided ({changeOrder}): finish this work order on revision {pinned}, as these pages show.
decided.REWORK: Decided ({changeOrder}): rework to revision {newer}. The new pages apply.
decided.SCRAP: Decided ({changeOrder}): the work in progress is scrapped. Stop and ask your team leader.
decided.HOLD: Decided ({changeOrder}): the work order is held. Stop and ask your team leader.

banner.newPages: The new pages are not on this tablet yet: ask your team leader for them.

problem.title: Spec problem
problem.question: What is wrong?
problem.faces: A photo of the spec or the piece only: keep faces out of the picture.
problem.photoOffline: A photo needs the network: send without it, the report is saved on this tablet
problem.detail: Say in a few words what is wrong.
problem.offline: No network: the report is saved on this tablet and goes when the network is back.
problem.linked: It goes to the office with this work order, operation and bundle. Your name is not on it.

held.detail: Say in a few words what is wrong

sent.title: Spec problem sent
sent.body: The office sees it on work order {number}, operation {seq}.

photo.waiting: The photo goes up as soon as the office has the report.
photo.failed: The photo did not go up. The report itself is there.

sent.next: Keep working to the spec you have until the office answers.
sent.failed: The office did not take it. Go back and report it again, or tell your team leader.

refusal.NOT_PUBLISHED: This version is no longer the one shown on the floor. Open the instruction again.
refusal.CLIENT_ID_REUSED: This tap was sent before with other details. Try again.

new.FIRST: Instruction for this operation: version {n}. It opens before Start: look at it once.
new.CHANGED: New instruction: version {n}. It opens before Start.
